body:
Restyle the existing Dispensary case and doctor-check/attention partials with Clean Look surfaces, blue scan hints and semantic warning states. Retain36px desktop/44px phone-tablet targets and the approved case-layout exception: three columns begin at1280px. Clinical conditions, actions, permissions, payloads and Verify-completes behavior are unchanged.

The nine-file scope contains three Vue files and six already approved appearance-test files. The partial scripts match main; the case script differs only in two presentation class strings and their comment. No backend, migration, grant, Treatment or TRI2 feature is bundled. All original appearance expectations remain; a final Prettier cleanup wraps three existing test files without changing their ASTs, assertions, literals, regexes or control flow, independently verified.

Validation chronology: the refreshed candidate passed all2,205 frontend tests, full TypeScript, production build and scoped ESLint. The expanded format check found three existing unformatted test files; their formatting-only repair passed all-nine-file Prettier and24 affected tests. A subsequent normal main merge adds the released prescribing-phrases slice without changing any of these nine scoped blobs; all24 affected tests pass again at the final head. Independent reviews bind final source/AST parity and current-main ancestry. Fresh exact-head CI is required for complete final integration before merge.

The three Vue files still match the original independently reviewed source and carried synthetic responsive/light-dark screenshots. This is not a new final-main browser run or complete Pharmacy demo parity. Existing dense inner medicine-field grouping at1440px is preserved; no full backend suite is claimed for this presentation-only slice.
